# Hershey fonts

`futural.jhf` (Roman simplex), `greek.jhf` (Greek simplex) and `mathlow.jhf` (mathematical symbols) are
from the Hershey font collection, in James Hurt's `.jhf` format, as distributed at
https://github.com/kamalmostafa/hershey-fonts. CS Script draws its text with them.

Acknowledgement, as the fonts' terms of use require:

> The Hershey Fonts were originally created by Dr. A. V. Hershey while working at the U.S. National
> Bureau of Standards. The format of the font data in this distribution was originally created by
> James Hurt, Cognition, Inc., 900 Technology Park Drive, Billerica, MA 01821.

The fonts may be used for any purpose, commercial or otherwise, provided this acknowledgement is
distributed with the font data, and may be converted to any format except the one distributed by the
U.S. National Technical Information Service.

`core/src/hershey_data.inc` is generated from these files by `tools/make_hershey.py`.
